sources.name: Control of Major Accident Hazards (COMAH) portal
sources.geography: Great Britain regulated establishments and competent-authority framework
sources.usage_limit: The portal identifies regulatory duties and data routes; it is not an establishment-specific risk probability or parcel score.

sources.name: Public information on establishments subject to COMAH 2015
sources.published_or_current: Current official establishment-search route reviewed 22 July 2026
sources.geography: Named COMAH establishments searchable by operator, establishment or postcode
sources.usage_limit: A matched establishment proves regulatory scope and published controls, not that every nearby parcel has equal exposure or that an accident will occur; exact establishment identity and distance/impact modelling are mandatory.

sources.name: Control Of Major Accident Hazards Regulations 2015
sources.geography: Great Britain COMAH operators, local authorities and people who could be affected
sources.usage_limit: Regulatory requirements describe duties and planning obligations; they do not quantify parcel-level accident likelihood or consequence.

sources.name: COMAH notifications
sources.published_or_current: Current official notification guidance reviewed 22 July 2026
sources.geography: Individual notified establishments and their immediate environment
sources.usage_limit: Notification fields can support exact establishment matching, but substance presence and immediate-environment descriptions require current records and do not establish off-site parcel impact without consequence zones.

sources.name: Submitting public information to the Competent Authority
sources.published_or_current: Current official operator guidance reviewed 22 July 2026
sources.geography: All COMAH establishments; additional information for upper-tier establishments
sources.usage_limit: Published operator statements are regulatory public information and must be joined to the exact establishment; they are not independently verified parcel exposure measurements.

sources.name: Control of Major Accident Hazards (COMAH) offences
sources.geography: England COMAH enforcement by the competent authority
sources.usage_limit: Enforcement guidance defines institutional responsibilities and response options; it is not evidence that a named site offended or that a parcel is unsafe.

sources.name: Dangerous Substances and Explosive Atmospheres Regulations 2002
sources.published_or_current: Current official DSEAR guidance reviewed 22 July 2026
sources.geography: Great Britain workplaces and members of the public potentially affected by work activity
sources.usage_limit: DSEAR duties apply broadly across workplaces; existence of a business or industrial use cannot be converted to a parcel hazard without exact substance, process and control evidence.

sources.name: Environmental Pollution Incidents Category 1 and 2
sources.geography: Completed and closed serious pollution incidents in England within Environment Agency remit
sources.usage_limit: The dataset has investigation and QA lag, recent incidents may be absent, records may change, and a site/property location does not prove owner responsibility; exact event geometry and date are required for parcel context.

sources.name: Pollution Inventory
sources.published_or_current: Dataset updated 17 April 2026; files cover reporting years through 2024
sources.geography: Large industrial sites regulated under environmental permits in England
sources.usage_limit: Reported annual mass releases cover whole permits and include point, fugitive and non-point sources; they are not ambient concentration, health impact or parcel exposure measurements.

sources.name: Environment Agency 2024 data on regulated businesses in England
sources.geography: England regulated sectors, permits, incidents, compliance, enforcement and waste crime
sources.usage_limit: Sector and permit information requires exact site identity, period and scheme definitions; regulatory non-compliance or sector totals cannot be copied to nearby parcels.

sources.name: Chief Regulator report 2024-25 supporting evidence
sources.published_or_current: 2024-25 reporting evidence published in 2025 and reviewed 22 July 2026
sources.geography: England regulated industrial, waste, water and agricultural sectors
sources.usage_limit: National and sector trends cannot identify a parcel event, cause or responsible operator; use only as benchmark and methodology context.

sources.name: Local resilience forums contact details
sources.geography: Police-area-based Local Resilience Forums across England and the UK
sources.usage_limit: LRF boundaries and community risk registers support planning and source discovery; they do not constitute a uniform parcel risk score and each local register requires edition, geography and scenario-specific interpretation.
